item.trailpack.snack_pouch.desc: Attaches to either side of a backpack. Holds food; hold that side's key to eat it, whatever is in your hand.
item.trailpack.bedroll_strap.desc: Attaches to the top of a backpack. Holds a sleeping bag; the key takes it out into your hand or ties it back on.
item.trailpack.armor_pouch.desc: Attaches to the front of a backpack. Holds a set of armor. Sneak + Swap Hands (default F) to swap.
message.trailpack.no_room_above: A backpack with a sleeping bag tied on needs free space above it.
gui.trailpack.module_remove: Removing this attachment drops whatever is in the slots it unlocks.
item.trailpack.tool_hook.desc: Attaches to either side of a backpack. Hangs a tool or lanterns.
key.trailpack.top: Top Attachment (take out / tie on sleeping bag)
message.trailpack.no_attachment.right: Nothing attached to the right of the backpack.
message.trailpack.no_attachment.left: Nothing attached to the left of the backpack.
message.trailpack.no_attachment.top: No bedroll strap on top of the backpack.
gui.trailpack.slot.att_side.title: Side Attachment Slot
gui.trailpack.slot.att_side.desc: Takes a Tool Hook or a Snack Pouch. Only one Snack Pouch per backpack.
gui.trailpack.slot.att_top.title: Top Attachment Slot
gui.trailpack.slot.att_armor.title: Armor Pouch Slot
gui.trailpack.slot.att_armor.desc: Attach an Armor Pouch to unlock the four armor slots next to it.
gui.trailpack.slot.side.title: Side Slot
gui.trailpack.slot.side.desc: Holds tools, lanterns or food depending on the attachment.
gui.trailpack.slot.hook.title: Tool Hook
gui.trailpack.slot.hook.desc: Hang a tool or lanterns (up to 64). Hung lanterns give off light. The key swaps it with the tool in your hand, or takes it out into your hand.
gui.trailpack.slot.pouch.title: Snack Pouch
gui.trailpack.slot.pouch.desc: Holds food. Hold the key to eat from the pouch, whatever is in your hand (release to cancel).
gui.trailpack.slot.bag.title: Sleeping Bag Slot
gui.trailpack.slot.bag.desc: Holds a rolled-up sleeping bag. The key swaps it with or ties on the sleeping bag in your hand, or takes it out into your hand if you aren't holding one. Place it with right-click.
gui.trailpack.locked.side: Attach a Tool Hook or Snack Pouch to use this slot.
gui.trailpack.locked.top: Attach a Bedroll Strap to use this slot.
gui.trailpack.locked.armor: Attach an Armor Pouch to use this slot.
gui.trailpack.slot.armor_0.title: Armor Slot — Head
gui.trailpack.slot.armor_0.desc: While wearing the backpack, Sneak + Swap Hands (default F) swaps these slots with your worn gear one by one. Empty slots take off what you wear. Curse of Binding items, and a backpack worn in the chest slot, stay put.
gui.trailpack.slot.armor_1.title: Armor Slot — Chest (elytra allowed)
gui.trailpack.slot.armor_1.desc: While wearing the backpack, Sneak + Swap Hands (default F) swaps these slots with your worn gear one by one. Empty slots take off what you wear. Curse of Binding items, and a backpack worn in the chest slot, stay put.
gui.trailpack.slot.armor_2.title: Armor Slot — Legs
gui.trailpack.slot.armor_2.desc: While wearing the backpack, Sneak + Swap Hands (default F) swaps these slots with your worn gear one by one. Empty slots take off what you wear. Curse of Binding items, and a backpack worn in the chest slot, stay put.
gui.trailpack.slot.armor_3.title: Armor Slot — Feet
gui.trailpack.slot.armor_3.desc: While wearing the backpack, Sneak + Swap Hands (default F) swaps these slots with your worn gear one by one. Empty slots take off what you wear. Curse of Binding items, and a backpack worn in the chest slot, stay put.
fml.menu.mods.info.description.trailpack: A backpack that fits vanilla lore. Wear it in the chest armor slot (or the Curios back slot), place it down, and add attachments: tool hooks, a snack pouch, a bedroll strap and an armor pouch.
